families.source: HSE COSHH hazardous-substance assessment and control guidance
families.topic: assessment, prevention, control, training and emergency planning for substances hazardous to health
families.evidence_requirements: COSHH risk depends on the exact substance, process, concentration, exposure route, duration, people exposed, control condition and emergency arrangements.

families.source: HSE Control of Noise at Work guidance
families.topic: assessment and control of occupational noise exposure
families.evidence_requirements: Noise risk depends on measured daily or weekly exposure, peak sound pressure, task duration, hearing-protection attenuation, worker susceptibility and control performance.

families.topic: assessment and control of hand-arm vibration exposure
families.evidence_requirements: Hand-arm vibration risk depends on tool vibration, task method, grip force, trigger time, maintenance, temperature and individual health factors.

families.topic: whole-body vibration from mobile machinery and work vehicles
families.evidence_requirements: Whole-body vibration risk depends on the vehicle or machine, surface condition, seat and suspension, shocks, posture, duration and individual factors.

families.topic: avoidance, assessment and reduction of hazardous manual handling
families.evidence_requirements: Manual-handling risk depends on the load, posture, reach, frequency, carrying distance, work environment, individual capability and available handling aids.

families.topic: contamination, cleaning, flooring and environmental slip and trip controls
families.evidence_requirements: Slip and trip risk depends on contamination, floor material and condition, cleaning method, footwear, lighting, weather, layout and human behaviour.

families.topic: risk assessment, supervision, communication and emergency arrangements for lone workers
families.evidence_requirements: Lone-working risk depends on the task, location, communications, supervision, competence, health, violence potential, travel and rescue arrangements.

families.topic: first-aid needs assessment, equipment, appointed persons and worker information
families.evidence_requirements: First-aid requirements depend on hazards, workforce size, shifts, geography, emergency-service access, vulnerable people and foreseeable injuries or illness.

families.topic: welfare facilities and healthy and safe workplace conditions
families.evidence_requirements: Workplace-facility requirements depend on premises type, work activity, occupancy, accessibility, climate, maintenance and worker needs.

families.topic: selection, provision, use and maintenance of PPE
families.evidence_requirements: PPE effectiveness depends on the hazard, specification, fit, compatibility, task, user behaviour, maintenance, storage and replacement condition.

families.topic: adequacy, suitability, fit testing, use and maintenance of RPE
families.evidence_requirements: RPE protection depends on contaminant type and concentration, required protection factor, face fit, compatibility, training, maintenance, filter condition and work rate.

families.source: HSE Control of Lead at Work guidance
families.topic: lead exposure prevention, control, hygiene, training and medical surveillance
families.evidence_requirements: Lead risk depends on lead form, process, air concentration, ingestion and skin routes, duration, hygiene, control performance and medical-surveillance findings.
